title: Tabata (original protocol)
creator: Izumi Tabata
description: The 1996 study protocol behind every "Tabata": eight 20-second bouts on a stationary bike at roughly 170% of VO2max, each followed by 10 seconds of rest, four minutes in total. Speed skaters doing it four days a week for six weeks matched the aerobic gains of an hour of steady cycling and improved anaerobic capacity too. The intensity is the point: if you can finish all eight rounds comfortably, it was not Tabata. Warm up first.

source.title: Tabata I. et al., Effects of moderate-intensity endurance and high-intensity intermittent training on anaerobic capacity and VO2max. Med Sci Sports Exerc 28(10):1327-30, 1996
source.author: Izumi Tabata et al.
source.license: Published protocol; description in our own words

steps.note: Max effort, ~170% VO2max; stop when cadence drops below 85 rpm
